title: Internal IT Admin
description:
VIPoint Solutions is looking for an Internal System Administrator to manage the day\-to\-day technology environment that keeps our team productive. The role covers IT asset management, end\-user support, network administration, and network and endpoint security administration, with strong hands\-on Ubuntu Linux expertise and involvement in the planned macOS transition.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Maintain a complete and accurate inventory of all electronic and IT assets.
  
Own the full asset lifecycle including procurement coordination, tagging, allocation, transfer, repair/RMA, and retirement or disposal.
  
Handle asset issue and return during employee onboarding and exit, including data wipe, re\-imaging, and sign\-off documentation.
  
Provide first and second\-line support for hardware and software issues.
  
Troubleshoot Ubuntu Linux, Windows, and macOS systems, business applications, VPN clients, printers, and audio/video conferencing setups.
  
Build and maintain standard OS images and provisioning workflows.
  
Support the planned macOS migration including device evaluation, pilot rollout, application compatibility mapping, data migration, and user training.
  
Manage the internal IT helpdesk queue and ensure tickets are resolved within agreed response times.
  
Administer and monitor the office LAN and WAN, including switches, access points, and ISP links.
  
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot routers, managed switches, Wi\-Fi access points, and VLAN segmentation.
  
Administer the Sophos firewall, including firewall rules, web and application filtering, VPN tunnels, IPS policies, and firmware updates.
  
Support internal server and infrastructure administration, including backup jobs, restore testing, and file/print services.
  
Manage patching, endpoint antivirus/EDR, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint hardening.
  
Maintain IT, network, security, and asset documentation.
  
Work closely with HR, Finance, vendors, and compliance teams on IT\-related requirements.
  
Requirements
  
Strong hands\-on Ubuntu Linux desktop administration and troubleshooting.
  
Working knowledge of Windows desktop administration and troubleshooting.
  
Exposure to macOS administration or willingness and aptitude to build it quickly.
  
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, NAT, VPN, and Wi\-Fi.
  
Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting routers, managed switches, and firewalls.
  
Experience with patch management, antivirus/endpoint protection tools, and vulnerability remediation.
  
Experience managing IT asset inventories and physical audits.
  
Familiarity with helpdesk/ticketing systems and structured incident handling.
  
Excellent spoken and written English.
  
Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
  
Ability to work independently, prioritise competing requests, and follow issues through to closure.
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Hands\-on experience with Sophos firewall / Sophos Central administration.
  
Experience working in an SEZ / Infopark unit and familiarity with asset movement documentation.
  
Exposure to Active Directory / LDAP, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365 administration.
  
Scripting ability using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  
Experience with RMM, MDM, or endpoint management tools.
  
Experience planning or executing a cross\-platform endpoint migration.
  
Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Security\+, CCNA, MCSA/MCSE, RHCSA, or Sophos Certified Engineer.
  
Basic understanding of ISO 27001 controls or similar security frameworks.
  
Why Join Us?
  
  

Work with a stable, growing IT services organisation with a global client base.
  
Join a Great Place to Work certified organisation.
  
Work from a modern SEZ campus facility at Infopark, Kakkanad.
  
Gain exposure to enterprise\-grade infrastructure and security practices.
  
Get hands\-on experience with modern endpoint, network, and security technologies.
  
Take ownership of a well\-defined domain with room to shape processes from the ground up.

title: IoT Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview**

The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist who can design end\-to\-end IoT solutions from the device/sensor layer through connectivity, edge processing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As the ISP transitions to an MSI model, IoT is a key growth vertical — spanning smart cities, industrial automation, smart metering, fleet management, healthcare IoT, and building management systems. The ideal candidate has a wide aperture across networking, cloud, data, and security, and can position IoT solutions confidently in commercial discussions.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures: device layer, connectivity (LPWAN / NB\-IoT / LTE\-M / 5G / Wi\-Fi 6 / LoRaWAN / Zigbee), edge, and cloud platform
* Architect IoT platforms: AWS IoT Core / Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub / IoT Central, Google Cloud IoT Core, ThingsBoard, or Bosch IoT Suite
* Design edge computing architectures: AWS Outposts / Local Zones, Azure IoT Edge, NVIDIA Jetson platforms for real\-time inference
* Develop smart city solution architectures: smart metering, smart lighting, traffic management, waste management, and environmental monitoring
* Architect industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for manufacturing, oil \& gas, utilities, and smart buildings — integrating OT/IT convergence via ISA\-95/IEC 62443
* Design IoT security frameworks: device identity management (PKI/X.509\), TLS/DTLS transport security, OTA update management, and network segmentation
* Position IoT connectivity services leveraging ISP assets (NB\-IoT, LTE\-M network, eSIM, APN management)
* Support MSI bids: technical solution writing, BoQ for gateways, sensors, platform licences, and integration services
* Maintain broad OEM awareness: Cisco IoT, Sierra Wireless, Telit, Advantech, Cradlepoint, and platform vendors
* Conduct market sensing — staying current on emerging IoT standards (Matter, Thread, Wi\-Fi HaLow, 5G URLLC for IIoT)

**◆ Technical Expertise — Broad Knowledge Requirements**

**The IoT Architect role requires broad technology coverage rather than a single deep\-stack specialism:**

* Connectivity layer: NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, LoRaWAN, Sigfox, Zigbee, Z\-Wave, Thread, Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Bluetooth LE — protocol trade\-offs and application mapping
* Edge platforms: AWS IoT Greengrass, Azure IoT Edge, Balena.io, or equivalent — deployment, container orchestration at edge
* Cloud IoT platforms: device registry, message brokering (MQTT/AMQP/HTTP), time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, Azure ADX)
* Data analytics: stream processing (Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs), batch analytics, and BI dashboarding (Grafana, Power BI, Tableau)
* AI/ML at edge: TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, or NVIDIA Triton inference — awareness of on\-device ML for anomaly detection
* Security: PKI for device identity, FIPS 140\-2, CVE awareness for embedded systems, IEC 62443 for ICS/SCADA environments
* Protocols: MQTT, CoAP, AMQP, LwM2M, OPC\-UA — strengths and appropriate use cases

**◆ Educational Qualifications**

* **Mandatory:** B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Telecommunications
* **Equivalent:** BCA / MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Networks) — considered with strong industry experience
* **Preferred:** Postgraduate qualifications (M.Tech / MBA in Technology Management) are a distinct advantage

**◆ Pre\-Sales \& Communication Skills**

**Candidates must demonstrate strong pre\-sales aptitude and communication capability:**

* Ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear, compelling business narratives for C\-suite and non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience in responding to RFPs, RFIs, and tenders — including solution write\-ups, BOQs, and commercial inputs
* Skilled in conducting customer workshops, discovery sessions, and proof\-of\-concept (PoC) demonstrations
* Ability to create high\-quality solution presentations, architecture diagrams, and proposals independently
* Comfortable presenting to diverse audiences — from NOC engineers to CTO/CIO level executives
* Strong written English for proposal and documentation; proficiency in MS Office / Visio / draw.io
* Active listening skills to identify unstated customer pain points and shape solutions accordingly
* Experience working alongside sales teams in deal pursuit, customer engagement, and solution shaping

**◆ Soft Skills \& Leadership Attributes**

* Self\-driven professional with the ability to manage multiple pursuits simultaneously under deadline pressure
* Collaborative team player who can mentor junior engineers and guide solution reviews
* Willingness to travel to customer sites, partner offices, and OEM briefings as required
* Intellectual curiosity — stays updated with emerging technologies and market trends
* Ability to engage with OEM vendor teams (Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Ericsson, ZTE, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.) for deal support and design validation

**◆ A Note on the IoT Architect Profile**

*The IoT Architect is intentionally a generalist\-with\-depth role. Candidates need not be experts in every technology layer, but must demonstrate genuine curiosity, the ability to rapidly learn new domains, and the commercial instinct to identify where IoT creates business value for customers. A track record of delivering at least two end\-to\-end IoT projects from concept through live operation is essential.*
